Package com.lemarketjames.reports.overnight

Class StubOvernightReportJob

java.lang.Object
com.lemarketjames.reports.overnight.StubOvernightReportJob
All Implemented Interfaces:
OvernightReportJob
@Component public class StubOvernightReportJob extends Object implements OvernightReportJob
Stands in for the heavy reports until they are built (LMKT-45 is built against a stub job).

It reads what a real report would: the run date's trades from reporting_trades, the one data source of every report, counted only (no single trade, nothing about a client). That exercises the read-only safeguards and the run date's range the way a real report will. The seed data (C3) already has trades on many days, so no seeding is needed for it.

It succeeds, unless reporting.overnight.stub.fail-with is set, in which case it fails with that message: that is how a failed run is shown on a running stack.
